Default bandwidth for the asynchronous estimators

Source: R/utils.R
default_bandwidth_async.Rd

Geometric midpoint of the grid kee_async_cv() searches, \(2 (Q_3 - Q_1) n^{-1/2}\), so it adapts to whatever units time is in.

Usage

default_bandwidth_async(times, n)

Arguments

times

Pooled observation times from both tables.

n

Number of subjects.

Value

A positive bandwidth.
